description: Explains the VA review options for a decision stage. Initial/Supplemental, Higher-Level Review and final Board decisions have different options, and a preference for a hearing or new evidence does not establish eligibility. Tailored options are returned only when the decision stage and ordinary modernized-review eligibility are confirmed; unknown, legacy, contested, remand-only and pending-review contexts return general information without tailored lanes. Does not calculate personal deadlines. Educational only.

decision_stage.description: The decision stage stated on the user’s own VA notice. A denial, a hearing preference or a historical decision does not establish the stage; "unknown" returns general information.

eligible_review_context_confirmed.description: True when the user has confirmed an ordinary modernized, non-contested issue within the applicable review window, with no pending review, motion or special exception. False or omitted returns general information without tailored lanes. Does not verify a filing deadline.

has_new_evidence.description: Whether the veteran has new, relevant evidence to add.

wants_hearing.description: Whether the veteran wants a hearing before a Veterans Law Judge. A hearing preference does not make a Board appeal available.
